chapter: Russell's band, records and Armstrong in the studio
title: Sonny Woods and the Palmer Brothers
summary: Sonny Woods was a fine but short tenor vocalist; the Palmer Brothers of Providence sang popular songs and recorded with the band but worked separately.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Now, tell me a little about Sonny Woods. You said he

Yeah, he was a very remarkable vocalist. He had a tenor voice, and he was a very good singer -- very good. And he had a lot of showmanship about him. But the only thing about him, he was short. You know, he was not tall and manly-looking, the way they like to see vocalists. You know what I mean? They've got to be six feet something tall and one of them things... Well, he wasn't tall or anything. He was too short. But he could sing. He could really sing. And a nice guy, too.
Well, did Russell feature him quite a bit, then?
And where did the Palmer Brothers come in?
They were part of the band or show or...?

I don't know... I know we made a record together. And we played different shows; they were in the different shows, in different theatres and things, or different places. But they weren't attached to the band or anything like that.
They were just there for the recording then, primarily.
Yeah . That recording anyway. No, they worked on their own. The theatre was... On their own. They weren't working with the band.
Oh yeah, very much so. Very much so.
Well, they could sing. They could really sing, you know. Three brothers could...
Providence, Rhode Island. That's why I guess they didn't get along as brothers.
Well, they had had plenty of time to rehearse...

No, I think the War broke them up. You know what I mean? The War come around, a couple of them had to go in the Service, and one of them was crippled, so he didn't have to go in the Service. He was no soloist either. He was great with the other two...
And what was the voicing? Tenor? Bass?
You're talkin' to me like I'm a musician!
Yeah, singin', I don't know one voice from the other. All I know is a good voice and a bad voice.
No. He can't... No musician can sing. If they can sing, they don't be musicians no more. Like Nat King Cole. He's a piano player. But...
